title: Python for reliable data work
learn: Functions, comprehensions, modules, exceptions, virtual environments, dependency files, type hints, file/JSON handling, logging and small automated tests. Review arrays, dictionaries, sets and basic time complexity.
deliverable: A script that reads a CSV, validates required columns and types, reports bad records, and writes a clean output. Include a test for an empty file and an invalid value. Use R1.

title: NumPy, pandas and analytical SQL
learn: Array shapes, indexing, broadcasting and vectorisation; DataFrames, missing values, duplicates, joins, groupby and dates. In SQL: joins, aggregations, CTEs and window functions.
deliverable: One exploratory notebook, three labelled charts and ten SQL queries on the same public dataset. Reconcile a count and an average between pandas and SQL. Use R2-R4.

title: Linear algebra and calculus you need
learn: Vectors, matrices, dot products, norms and matrix multiplication; function slopes, derivatives, partial derivatives, gradients and the chain rule. Connect dimensions to features and model weights.
deliverable: A NumPy implementation of a linear prediction and squared loss. Perform several gradient-descent updates on a tiny example and explain why the loss changes. Use R5 selectively.

title: Probability and practical statistics
learn: Mean, median, variance, distributions, conditional probability, Bayes rule, sampling bias, confidence intervals, correlation versus causation, and the meaning of a hypothesis test.
deliverable: A short dataset report with a target definition, a data dictionary, a missing-data summary, a simple bootstrap interval for a mean, and three possible sources of bias. Use R5-R6.
